title.zh: Enhancing Program Integrity and Integrity and Interagency Coordination in the Administration of the H-1B Nonimmigrant Visa Program

current_state.zh: The White House issued an executive order aimed at enhancing program integrity and interagency coordination in the administration of the H-1B nonimmigrant visa program, citing concerns that the program has strayed from its original purpose.
